text_block_list.text:
Check it out, Trainer! That was Golshi's
all-out
dash! Burn it into your mind!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: It was great... but you can aim even higher!

text_block_list.text:
Right?! My dazzling display and the
resulting
thunderous applause is bound
to have changed
the world's weather!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You don't suppose the northern lights
might have
shifted to Japan as a result,
do you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We ought to celebrate our new
Japanese lights
with a fancy fish platter!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Aim even higher? You mean... to the
skies?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea! I was just getting
bored of
being ground-bound!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
For centuries, Umamusume have
dreamed of
racing through the skies, but
we'll be the ones to
make it happen!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But first, we gotta scope out the turf!
Let's grab
some binoculars and watch
the airplanes in their
natural habitat!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And so, Голд Шипп drags me off
bird-watching...
Or rather,
plane-watching.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп grabs a fishing pole and sets
off to
catch some fish. It takes
everything I have to stop
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
